Command:

```
cd /p/projects/samagotchi-n7-tps && ruby -e '
require "net/http"; require "json"
key = ENV["LLM_API_KEY"]
if key.to_s.empty? then puts "NO KEY"; exit 0 end
uri = URI("https://llm.example/v1/chat/completions")
req = Net::HTTP::Post.new(uri)
req["Authorization"] = "Bearer #{key}"; req["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
req.body = JSON.generate(model: "deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash", stream: true, max_tokens: 250,
  messages: [{role: "user", content: "What is 17*23? Think step by step, briefly."}])
t0 = Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC)
Net::HTTP.start(uri.host, uri.port, use_ssl: true, read_timeout: 60) do |http|
  http.request(req) do |res|
    res.read_body do |chunk|
      chunk.each_line do |line|
        next unless line.start_with?("data:")
        dt = Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC) - t0
        puts format("%6.2fs %s", dt, line.strip[0,160])
      end
    end
  end
end
'
```
